nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): guarded addition with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): guarded subtraction with underflow require.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): guarded multiplication with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): guarded division requiring non-zero divisor.
Owned() constructor setting owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: sets newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then moves ownership.
CyborgDoge() constructor: initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and initial balance.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): reads balances mapping.
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to'.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowance for msg.sender.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves balances.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): reads allowed mapping.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves then calls spender.receiveApproval.
Fallback payable function that reverts on any plain ETH transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external ERC20 transfer out of held tokens.
address public owner of the Owned contract.
address public newOwner pending ownership transfer.
string public symbol of the token (CYDOGE).
string public name of the token (CyborgDoge).
uint8 public decimals of the token (18).
uint public _totalSupply holding the total token units.
mapping(address => uint) balances tracking token ownership.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed tracking allowances.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, transfers and allowances.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) transferring control to an arbitrary address.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied arbitrary contract.

balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer writes balances for msg.sender and for 'to'.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom updates balances of from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before handing control to the spender contract.
